description: Checks an IPv4 address against the abuse.ch Feodo Tracker botnet C2 blocklist (Emotet, QakBot and similar). A hit returns the port, online status, malware family, country, AS and first and last seen dates. Covers only the C2 servers this feed tracks. Choose this tool for: Checks an IPv4 address against the abuse.ch Feodo Tracker. Close alternatives on this server: security_barracuda_reputation (Checks an IPv4 mail-sending address against the Barracuda); security_blocklist_de (Checks an IPv4 address against the Blocklist.de 'all' list). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
